s: I am Maya, and today Lena and I are talking about faces, feelings, and first impressions.
I love this topic, because the first thing we notice about a person is often how they look, but the second thing we notice is how they make us feel.
Our first word today is attract.
When something can attract you, it makes you interested in it.
A warm smile can attract people, a beautiful voice can attract listeners, and bright colours can attract our eyes.
A kind person does not try hard to attract attention, but people still want to be near them.
My grandmother always said that good manners attract good friends.
A beautiful picture in the window can attract customers, and friendly workers inside can attract them back a second time.
So attract is about pulling interest towards you, like a magnet.
Speaking of first impressions, let me describe my cousin.
She has long auburn hair, and everyone remembers it.
Auburn is a reddish brown colour, usually for hair.
Her auburn hair shines in the sun, almost like copper.
My sister tried to colour her hair auburn last year, but it came out too red, and she felt a little awkward about it.
Oh, awkward is another great word for today.
Awkward means difficult, embarrassing, or not graceful.
We all know that awkward moment when you wave at someone, and they were not waving at you.
That happened to me last week.
I felt so awkward that I wanted to disappear.
An awkward moment is never as bad as we think.
Most people forget it in five minutes.
And here is something that always helps in an awkward situation.
Affectionate means showing love or liking.
An affectionate word or a warm hug can melt any awkward feeling away.
Before we go further, let me tell you about something that can help you learn words like these every single day.

The app is free to install, so come and join us today.
I use the app every morning, and the shadowing stories are my favourite part.
We were talking about being affectionate.
My dog is the most affectionate animal I know.
He waits at the door for me every evening.
My cat is affectionate too, but only when she wants food.
Still, an affectionate pet can make a whole house feel warm.
People who are affectionate usually attract strong friendships, because everyone loves feeling loved.
My uncle is very affectionate, and he is also famous in our family for another reason.
Bald means having little or no hair on your head.
He started to go bald when he was thirty.
And does he feel awkward about being bald?
He says being bald is beautiful in its own way, and honestly, he is right.
He has a big grey beard, and the beard with the bald head looks strong and kind at the same time.
Children are not scared of him, because he is so affectionate and funny.
A beard is the hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.
Some men grow a beard because it looks warm, and some grow one because a beard can attract a lot of compliments.
My brother grew a beard last winter.
At first it looked a little awkward, because it grew in patches.
But after two months, his beard looked full and beautiful, and now he will not cut it.
My father had a beard when I was small.
His beard was auburn when he was young, the same auburn colour as your cousin's hair, but now it is white as snow.
It is funny how hair tells a story.
Auburn hair, a grey beard, a bald head.
What is beautiful on the inside matters much more.
Beautiful is our next word, and it is a word with a big heart.
A person can be beautiful, a song can be beautiful, and a kind action can be the most beautiful thing of all.
I think an affectionate heart is beautiful.
When someone helps a stranger, that moment is beautiful, and it can attract kindness from everyone around.
Let me share a small story about an awkward day that turned beautiful.
Last spring, I went to a new class.
I did not know anyone, I dropped my books in front of everyone, and I felt completely awkward.
A girl with auburn hair helped me pick up my books.
She was so affectionate and warm that my awkward feeling disappeared in one minute.
Her kindness was beautiful, and it taught me that warm people attract warm people.
That is a beautiful story, Maya.
We cannot choose our hair or our face, but we can choose to be affectionate, and we can choose how we act when we feel awkward.
And now, a quick word for everyone listening who wants to remember all of this.
In the Muse English app, today's seven words are waiting for you with photos, pronunciation, and a word quiz.
You can shadow today's story sentence by sentence, collect points, climb the leaderboard, and follow the grammar path step by step.
Everything is free, and a little practice every day really works.
Open the Muse English app after this episode and keep your streak alive.
Yes, do it right after we finish.
Now let us look at our words one more time with fresh examples.
A bright window display can attract shoppers.
A friendly smile can attract new friends.
And auburn is not just for hair in stories.
Autumn leaves can be auburn, and an auburn sunset can paint the whole sky.
When I see that colour, I always think of warm and beautiful evenings.
A new job can feel awkward.
A first date can feel very awkward.
Even famous actors feel awkward on stage.
It is a normal human feeling.
And the cure is often simple.
Small affectionate actions make big awkward moments small.
Let us not forget our two gentlemen's words.
Bald is a normal, natural word.
Many strong and beautiful actors are bald.
And a beard can be short, long, black, grey, or even auburn.
A beard is just hair, but for many men it is part of who they are.
My grandfather was bald, and he never grew a beard, but his affectionate laugh was the most beautiful sound in our house.
When he laughed, his whole face would attract everyone to the kitchen table.
You see, listeners, these seven words are not just words.
Attract, auburn, awkward, affectionate, bald, beard, and beautiful.
They help you describe real people and real feelings in English.
Let us do a tiny practice together.
Is their hair dark, or is it auburn?
Let me paint one more picture for you, listeners.
The smell of fresh bread can attract hungry visitors from the whole street.
An old man with a long white beard is selling flowers, and his affectionate dog sits beside him, happy to meet everyone.
And at the next table, a young woman with auburn hair is selling paintings.
Her work is beautiful, and the colours attract a small crowd.
Nobody feels awkward there, because the market feels like one big family.
And maybe a bald baker is giving free cakes to children, with a big affectionate smile.
A beard here, auburn hair there, a bald head shining in the sun, and beautiful kindness everywhere.
What I love about that picture is that every person in it is different, and every person in it is beautiful in a different way.
English gives you the words to describe them all with love and respect.
And think of a beautiful moment from this week.
Maybe it was awkward at first, but it ended well.
Try to tell that story in English tonight, using at least three of today's words.
Thank you for listening to Muse English today.
Keep practising, keep smiling, and remember, a kind and affectionate heart is always beautiful.
Do not feel awkward about making mistakes in English.
We will see you tomorrow with seven fresh new words.
